style: Bright, cheerful marching band characters. Children of many different skin tones and hair styles. Front view, standing straight at attention, same size and pose for every musician so they line up neatly.

assets.name: drum
assets.prompt: A girl with dark brown skin and curly black hair in puffs, red band uniform with gold braid and white cross straps, a white snare drum at her waist, holding drumsticks. Tall black shako hat with gold trim and a plume. Full body from the top of the plume down to the shoes, standing straight at attention facing the viewer, feet together, the instrument held close in front of the body.
